featured_reviews.review_text:
This was our first couple spa experience, and unfortunately, it turned out to be extremely disappointing.

We visited Elite Spa in Borivali after booking a scheduled appointment. As soon as we arrived, the staff immediately started pushing a ₹7,000 membership package in a very hasty manner. We politely informed them that we would first like to experience a session before deciding on any membership.

From the beginning, the hospitality was extremely poor. There was no warm welcome, no proper guidance, and no effort to make first-time customers comfortable. We were simply directed to a room and the door was shut behind us.

The massage experience itself was highly unsatisfactory. The masseuses assigned to us appeared very inexperienced, almost like trainees. We had opted for a Balinese massage, which is supposed to involve moderate and consistent pressure, but the pressure throughout the session was extremely uneven — either too light or unnecessarily harsh.

At one point, I had to pause the session and step out to discuss with my partner whether we should even continue. We then explained our expectations again to the therapists, but even after restarting, the massage remained inconsistent and unprofessional.

The massage strokes were incomplete, coordination between the therapists was poor, and communication was extremely difficult because they could not properly understand Hindi, Marathi, or even clear English. One therapist was constantly guiding the other during the session, making us feel more like practice subjects than paying customers.

Since time had already been wasted, the therapists then rushed through the remaining massage just to complete the session. Even the shower experience afterward was terrible. The shower system had multiple nozzles and unstable temperature control, making it genuinely unsafe — if you are not quick enough, the water suddenly becomes extremely hot.

When we politely informed the receptionist about our dissatisfaction, instead of accountability or any attempt to resolve the issue, we were told that the therapists complained they “couldn’t give a good massage because the beds were high.” That explanation was honestly unbelievable and highly unprofessional.

No compensation, no concern, and no effort to improve the experience — just a casual “sorry ma’am and sir.”

The only positive takeaway from this experience is that we are glad we did not purchase the membership.
